title.narrative: Foster dialogue on pathways for a revitalized Middle East Peace Process

description.narrative:
Overall Objective


Build conditions for regional comprehensive peace and the emergence of a unified and more democratic Palestinian polity.



Specific Objectives


1.To support dialogue for regional comprehensive peace among relevant regional and international actors, ensuring policy inputs from the Women¿s Advisory Council. [Workstream 1: Support to Regional Comprehensive Peace]


2.To mitigate the internal Palestinian crisis by supporting an informal intra-Palestinian dialogue process to explore options for a viable roadmap towards Palestinian reunification and a more effective and democratic Palestinian political system. [Workstream 2: Intra-Palestinian dialogue process]
